IntentionKind.description:
B1's options: `create`, `seek` and `news` are its activities of the same name, and `go` is
whichever activity takes them to `target`.
IntentionKind.title: IntentionKind

description:
Something `owner` said they'd do, which they favour from when it's due until it's done or
expires.

owner.description: The resident who said they'd do it.
owner.title: Owner

target.description: For `go` the location, and for `seek` whom they'll seek out. For `create` the wall or location to make it at, and for `news` the terminal, or null for wherever they'd usually go.
target.title: Target

description.description: What they said they'd do, in a few words, for prompts. For `create` the idea itself, e.g. "a mural of an ocean of coffee with cups half-sunk in it".
description.title: Description

promised_to.description: Who they said it to. Each remembers if it's broken.
promised_to.title: Promised To

due.description: When they mean to do it: `created` for now.
due.title: Due

expires.description: When it's dropped if they haven't done it.
expires.title: Expires

conversation_id.description: The conversation it came from. The owner's `conversation` memory of it carries the same id. Null if it didn't come from one.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

title: Intention
